"How are we feeling tonight, ma'am? Is the pain any better than this afternoon?" "Oh dear, Doctor, there ain't a spot on this old body that doesn't hurt. Lying flat on my back day in, day out, my back's gone all stiff and creaky. I just wanna go home, and quick." "I know. It must hurt terribly. Still, the bone needs proper rest to knit back together, so staying in bed really is best." "Aigoo, I'm so bored I could scream. All I do is blink at the ceiling — I don't even know what I'm doing anymore. And time crawls something dreadful." The one unloading her grievances was a seventy-three-year-old grandmother who had fallen from the second floor of her house while hanging out the laundry — multiple trauma, plate fixation surgery, and all four limbs now splinted. Orthopedics being what it was, the ward was full of elderly fracture patients like her, and to patients like these, So-yul was all but an idol. This was the apocalypse. Bringing an elderly person from an unknown space into a dying world-how could that ever be considered appropriate? But only those who had crawled through the same mud could understand. After enduring endless torment, when you finally claw your way up to a sliver of success, a desperate yearning takes root. You crave to share it. You crave to show the person closest to you. Yuan Twelve had summoned his grandmother from that unknown space for a single reason: to tell her, with his own voice, that she could rest easy. The obedient grandson she had rescued from a garbage dump could finally feed himself. No one looked down on him anymore. Besides, even if the world was ending, this was still the pinnacle of Yuan Twelve’s life. Without the apocalypse, he would still be drowning in the dregs of society. Those who hadn’t lived it could never comprehend the psychology behind it. “Good grandson, why didn’t you agree when those people came to find you yesterday?” The old woman spoke again. An unremarkably dressed man wearing a mask opened the door and stepped out. Judging from his brow, he was probably in his forties or fifties. He looked around, fixed his gaze in one direction, and hurried away. Inside the taxi, the driver quietly observed his every move. Once the man had gone some distance, the driver took out his phone, opened a Certain Penguin Chat App, and entered a group called 【Temporary Shizhou City Haunting Chat Group】. Lu Yibei had spent heavily to have the Online Old Pervert establish this chat group specifically for Lin Nian to communicate with her informants. Judging by the Mana carried in their reverberations, it was likely some kind of wide-area buff targeting allies. “……” Yunseok raised his head and looked at the approaching army. It numbered at least tens of thousands. Even now, more soldiers continued emerging from the Fissure in real time. Yunseok suddenly wondered how Rick and the Queen had gathered so many troops, but one glance was enough to tell him that they had not used any ordinary method. BOOM—! BOOM—! Were they what people called undead? Humans, demons, elves, and beastfolk. Although the army consisted of all kinds of races, not a trace of life could be felt from their eyes. It was the power to twist established laws, which the Heavenly Demon had called the upper dantian. ‘No. More precisely, is that the [Doom] Authority Rick received from the Queen…?’ Only an army like this could have attempted something as audacious as invading the Tower.
